Record Class SeasonalDrinkRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
SeasonalDrinkRequest
public record SeasonalDrinkRequest(String name, String category, BigDecimal priceSmall, BigDecimal priceMedium, BigDecimal priceLarge, List<SeasonalDrinkRequest.IngredientRequirement> ingredients) extends Record
Everything a manager enters to create one seasonal drink, checked for mistakes before any database work starts.

A seasonal drink is handled differently from a regular menu item. When a regular drink is added, it only needs the standard ingredients for its category. A seasonal drink, such as a peppermint milk tea, needs its own recipe, and that recipe may use an ingredient the shop has never stocked, such as peppermint syrup. This request therefore carries the full recipe, and each ingredient says whether it already exists in the inventory or must be created and ordered along with the drink.

Building this object runs all of the validation, so a request that exists is always safe to hand to the code that writes to the database. The rules mirror the CHECK constraints in sql/commands.sql, which lets the manager see a clear message instead of a raw database error.
